preferred_term: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
evidence_quote: Evidence showed adding a sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitor to existing treatment with an angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitor or angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), beta-blocker and mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist (MRA) reduced mortality and hospitalisation for heart failure without important increases in adverse events. The committee agreed that treatment combinations for people with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction should now include an SGLT2 inhibitor.
